name: Slime

abilities.name: Engulf (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage. On a hit the target is Rooted until it beats the slime's attack successes with Strength + Athletics.

trait: Splits in two when hit by a blade but not destroyed; each half is an F rank slime with half its boxes.
found: Sewers, dungeon floors 1 to 10, damp fields.

name: Water Slime

abilities.name: Water Bolt
abilities.text: Casts the Water Rank 1 spell.

abilities.name: Douse (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and ends the Burning condition on anything it touches.

trait: Takes half damage from Fire attacks, rounded down.
found: Rivers, rain-soaked caves, the Flooded Caverns.

name: Acid Slime

abilities.name: Acid Touch (melee)
abilities.text: Acid damage. On a hit, the target's armor loses 1 Armor until repaired.

trait: Weapons that hit it lose 1 Rating for the scene unless cleaned.
found: Garbage pits, alchemy lab drains, dungeon floors 6 to 20.

name: Poison Slime

abilities.name: Venom Splash
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Poison damage and the Poisoned condition.

abilities.name: Engulf (melee)
abilities.text: As a Slime.

trait: Anything that bites or swallows it is Poisoned.

name: Magma Slime

abilities.name: Magma Glob
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Burning damage and the Burning condition.

abilities.name: Molten Body
abilities.text: Anyone who hits it with an unarmed attack takes burning damage equal to its Damage pool.

trait: Leaves a trail of burning ground (Burning Ground, Fire Rank 2) where it moves.
loot: Ember core (D rank fire focus material).

name: Metal Slime

abilities.name: Steel Ram (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Flee
abilities.text: As a Reaction when hit, move 2 zones.

trait: Its BDT is doubled, and it tries to run from every fight. Defeating one is worth bragging about.
found: Rare, anywhere in the Grand Dungeon.
loot: Metal slime alloy (B rank weapon material, worth 1 Large Gold).

name: Great Slime

abilities.name: Engulf (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage, and a target it hits is pulled inside: Rooted, and takes the slime's Damage pool again each Upkeep until it escapes with Strength + Athletics.

abilities.name: Split Off
abilities.text: Once per scene, spend 3 mana to release two Slimes.

trait: Dozens of slimes merged into one. It is slow but almost impossible to push.

name: Slime Swarm

abilities.name: Smother (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage to everyone in adjacent zones; each defends separately.

trait: A swarm of tiny slimes that counts as one creature filling a 2x2 area. Area attacks deal +2 damage to it.

name: Giant Rat

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage. On a hit roll 1d10; on a 1 the target catches a fever (-1 die on physical rolls until healed).

trait: Usually found in packs of 3 to 6.

name: Horned Rabbit

abilities.name: Horn Charge
abilities.text: Move up to 2 zones in a straight line and attack. Piercing damage.

trait: Harmless until startled, then very fast.
found: Fields and forests across the Central Continent.

name: Acid Wolf

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Acid Spit
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Acid damage; the target's armor loses 1 Armor until repaired.

trait: Hunts in packs of 4 to 8 that circle and spit before closing in.

name: Assault Dog

abilities.name: Pack Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage, +2 dice if another Assault Dog is adjacent to the target.

trait: Packs of 5 to 10 that never stop chasing. Movement 2.

name: Pax Coyote

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.text: Every enemy who hears it rolls Composure + Presence against its Attack; those who fail suffer -2 dice on their next turn.

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

trait: Packs follow a single alpha. Kill the alpha and the pack scatters.

name: Cave Crawler

abilities.name: Mandibles (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Ceiling Drop
abilities.text: Attacks from above with +2 dice the first time it strikes in a fight.

trait: Climbs on walls and ceilings as easily as floors.

name: Dire Boar

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.text: Move up to 2 zones in a straight line and attack. Piercing damage; the target is knocked Prone.

trait: Keeps charging even when Incapacitated once: it gets one last Gore before it falls.
found: Forests of the Central and Milis continents.

name: Giant Spider

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage and the Poisoned condition.

abilities.name: Web
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. The target is Rooted until it beats the spider's Attack successes with Strength + Athletics.

trait: Ignores Difficult Terrain made of webs and can walk on walls.
found: Dark forests, the Catacombs, abandoned mines.

name: Hellhound

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.text: Casts the Fire Rank 3 spell.

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage and the Burning condition.

trait: Immune to Burning. Hunts in pairs.
found: The Infernal Halls, volcanic regions of the Demon Continent.
loot: Ember fang (C rank fire focus material).

name: Forest Bear

abilities.name: Maul (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage. Two attacks against the same target each turn.

abilities.name: Roar
abilities.text: Enemies in adjacent zones resist with Composure + Presence or suffer -2 dice on their next attack.

trait: Fiercely protective of cubs.

name: Rock Turtle

abilities.name: Shell Slam (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and the target is knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Stone Shell
abilities.text: As a Reaction, +3 BDT until its next turn.

trait: Nearly unbreakable from the front; its underside has half the BDT. Prized for its meat.
loot: Shell plates (C rank armor material), meat for a whole village.

name: Thunderbird

abilities.name: Lightning Dive
abilities.text: Moves up to 4 zones and attacks. Electric damage.

abilities.name: Storm Call
abilities.text: Casts Thunderstorm (Fire + Water + Air + Nature) once per scene.

trait: Flies at double movement. Lives inside storm clouds.
loot: Storm feathers (B rank Air focus material).

name: Griffon

abilities.name: Talons (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Snatch and Drop
abilities.text: On a hit against a Medium or smaller target, carry it up 2 zones and drop it for falling damage.

trait: Flies at double movement. Can be tamed as a mount by a patient rider.
found: Cliffs of the Central Continent, Asura mountains.
loot: Feathers, eggs (worth a Small Gold to a breeder).

name: Manticore

abilities.name: Tail Volley
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Roll once against up to 3 targets; piercing damage and the Poisoned condition.

abilities.name: Maul (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

trait: Speaks a little and enjoys taunting its prey.

name: Basilisk

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.text: Every enemy who can see it resists with Wisdom + Composure; one that fails is Rooted as its legs turn to stone, and if it fails again next turn it is turned to stone (Petrify, Earth + Nature + Bright + Shade).

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

trait: Looking away or using a mirror gives -2 dice to attack it but immunity to the gaze.

name: Terminate Boa

abilities.name: Constrict (melee)
abilities.text: Crushing damage; the target is Rooted and takes the Damage pool again each Upkeep until it breaks free with Strength + Athletics.

abilities.name: Swallow
abilities.text: A Rooted Medium target at 0 Bashing boxes left is swallowed whole.

trait: Hides in tall grass and trees; first attack each fight gets +3 dice.

name: Chimera

abilities.name: Three Heads
abilities.text: Three attacks a turn: lion bite (piercing), goat horns (kinetic), serpent tail (piercing and Poisoned).

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.text: Casts Fireball (Fire Rank 5) once per scene.

trait: Each head can be targeted separately (one third of its boxes each); losing a head loses that attack.
found: Fighting pits, the Ironwood Colosseum, Demon Continent wilds.

name: Behemoth

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.text: Moves up to 3 zones; everything in its path defends or takes kinetic damage and is knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Tremor Roar
abilities.text: Casts Earthquake (Earth Rank 5).

abilities.name: Horn Gore (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage, +3 dice against structures.

trait: Fills a 4x4 area. Town Rapan is built inside the ribs of one.
found: Deep in the Demon Continent; one every few generations.
loot: Bones for a town, hide for an army.

name: Mandrake

abilities.name: Scream
abilities.text: Every creature in adjacent zones resists with Composure + Endurance; those who fail lose their next action.

trait: Pulling it from the ground triggers the scream automatically.
loot: Mandrake root (alchemy, worth a Small Silver).

name: Myconid Scout

abilities.name: Spore Burst
abilities.text: Casts the Nature Rank 2 spell.

abilities.name: Club (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

trait: Myconids talk with spores; anyone caught in a cloud hears their thoughts as a buzzing.

name: Carnivorous Vine

abilities.name: Vine Whip
abilities.text: Casts the Nature Rank 2 spell.

abilities.name: Digest
abilities.text: A Rooted target takes acid damage each Upkeep.

trait: Looks like a normal hedge until it moves.

name: Treant

abilities.name: Branch Slam (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and the target is knocked back one zone.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.text: Casts the Nature Rank 1 spell on everyone in adjacent zones.

trait: Takes double damage from Fire attacks. Many are old enough to talk, slowly.

name: Spore Mother

abilities.name: Spore Cloud
abilities.text: Casts Miasma Bloom (Air + Nature + Shade).

abilities.name: Spawn
abilities.text: Once per turn, a Myconid Scout grows from the floor in an adjacent zone.

trait: Rooted in place. Burning it ends the spawning.

name: Kobold Scout

abilities.name: Spear (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Scent Track
abilities.text: Adds 3 dice to Awareness rolls to track by smell.

trait: Kobolds are canine and loyal to their pack; a scout that spots a party runs to fetch the rest.
found: Demon Continent hills and mines, the Upper Halls.

name: Kobold Packmaster

abilities.name: Rally Bark
abilities.text: Allies who hear it add 1 die to attacks this turn.

abilities.name: Glaive (melee, Reach)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

trait: Leads 4 to 6 Kobold Scouts.

name: Orc Warrior

abilities.name: Great Cleaver (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Tusk Charge
abilities.text: Move 2 zones in a line and attack with +1 die.

trait: Orcs are pigfolk: hearty, loud, and fond of a good meal and a good fight. Most serve Raja Iblis Baglahagla.

name: Orc Shaman

abilities.name: Stone Spike
abilities.text: Casts the Earth Rank 3 spell.

abilities.name: War Chant
abilities.text: Allies in sight add 1 die to damage this turn.

trait: Usually travels with a band of Orc Warriors.
loot: Bone charms, a D rank focus.

name: Orc Warlord

abilities.name: Greataxe (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Iron Body
abilities.text: Casts the Battle Aura Rank 2 spell.

trait: Commands a war band of 10 or more. Respects anyone who beats them in a fair duel.

name: Lizardman Warrior

abilities.name: Spear and Shield (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.text: Every enemy in adjacent zones defends or is knocked Prone.

trait: Swims as well as it walks. Slows in the cold (-1 die).

name: Lizardman Shaman

abilities.name: Venom
abilities.text: Casts Venom (Water + Shade).

abilities.name: Quagmire
abilities.text: Casts Quagmire (Water + Earth).

trait: Keeper of the tribe's old songs.

name: Bugfolk Drone

abilities.name: Mandibles (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Hive Signal
abilities.text: Every drone within 3 zones knows where the drone's target is.

trait: Ant-like workers and soldiers. They fight as one.
found: Hive mounds in the Demon Continent.

name: Mantis Blade

abilities.name: Twin Scythes (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.text: Moves 3 zones in a single jump.

trait: Duelists of the bugfolk. Bow before attacking.

name: Hive Queen

abilities.name: Brood Call
abilities.text: Once per turn, 2 Bugfolk Drones arrive in adjacent zones.

abilities.name: Acid Spray
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Roll once against up to 3 targets; acid damage.

abilities.name: Hive Mind
abilities.text: All bugfolk in sight add 1 die to every roll.

trait: Never leaves the hive. The drones fight to the last for her.
loot: Royal jelly (A rank alchemy, worth a Large Gold).

name: Goblin

abilities.name: Shiv (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Dirty Trick
abilities.text: Throws sand or a gadget: the target suffers -2 dice on its next roll.

trait: Clever, quick, and fond of anything with moving parts.

name: Goblin Tinkerer

abilities.name: Boom Jar
abilities.text: Thrown, up to double Strength in zones. Burning damage to everyone in the target zone.

abilities.name: Turret
abilities.text: Once per scene, places a clockwork crossbow that attacks each turn with its Attack pool.

trait: Never fights fair and never apologizes.

name: Ogre

abilities.name: Club (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and the target is knocked back one zone.

abilities.name: Grab and Throw
abilities.text: On a hit against a Medium or smaller target, throw it 2 zones.

trait: Ogres left the Demon Continent long ago because they prefer peace. Calm and gentle until a friend is hurt.

name: Troll

abilities.name: Claws (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Regenerate
abilities.text: Neutralizes 2 Bashing each Upkeep unless it took burning or acid damage since its last turn.

trait: Hard to kill and easy to anger.

name: Minotaur

abilities.name: Greataxe (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Bull Rush
abilities.text: Move 3 zones in a line; everything in the way defends or is knocked Prone.

trait: Never lost in a maze; always knows the way to its target.

name: Automaton Servitor

abilities.name: Tool Arm (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Repair
abilities.text: Neutralizes 1 Bashing on another construct in an adjacent zone.

trait: Household and factory automatons. Most are harmless unless their orders change.

name: Living Armor

abilities.name: Sword (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Empty Shell
abilities.text: Hits that strike a gap (excess successes of 3 or more) only deal half damage.

trait: A suit of armor animated by a lingering will.

name: Mud Golem

abilities.name: Mud Slam (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and the target is Rooted until the end of its next turn.

trait: Reforms after being destroyed unless its core is removed.
found: Swamps, the work sites of earth mages.

name: Clockwork Sentinel

abilities.name: Halberd (melee, Reach)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Alarm
abilities.text: Every construct on the floor knows where intruders are.

trait: Guards one door forever.

name: Automaton Duelist

abilities.name: Rapier (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Learned Style
abilities.text: Copies the Combat Style of the last enemy that hit it, adding 1 die to its attacks.

trait: Built for sport. Some have fought thousands of bouts.

name: Stone Golem

abilities.name: Stone Fist (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Stoneskin
abilities.text: Casts the Earth Rank 5 spell on itself once per fight.

trait: Slow and relentless. Movement 1.

name: Iron Golem

abilities.name: Iron Fist (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Furnace Vent
abilities.text: Every creature in adjacent zones takes burning damage equal to its Damage pool.

trait: Immune to Poisoned and Chilled.

name: War Automaton

abilities.name: Cannon Arm
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Kinetic damage to the target zone and adjacent zones.

abilities.name: Stomp (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and knocked Prone.

trait: Built for the God Wars or the Kaiju lines. Some still wander with old orders.

name: Mana Construct

abilities.name: Spell Absorption
abilities.text: When a spell hits it, roll its Defense; each success cancels 1 damage and gives it 1 mana.

abilities.name: Discharge
abilities.text: Spends stored mana to cast any single-school spell of rank 5 or lower that hit it this fight.

trait: Built by the Mages Guild to test, and to punish, spellcasters.
found: Mages Guild vaults, the Arcane Laboratories.

name: Skeleton

abilities.name: Rusty Blade (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

trait: Takes half damage from piercing attacks, rounded down.

name: Zombie

abilities.name: Grab and Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage, and the target is Rooted until it beats the zombie's attack with Strength + Athletics.

trait: Keeps coming. Stands back up once unless its head is destroyed.

name: Ghoul

abilities.name: Claws (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; the target resists with Fortitude + Endurance or loses its next action to paralysis.

trait: Eats the dead. Fast and clever.

name: Ghost

abilities.name: Chilling Touch (melee)
abilities.text: Cold damage; ignores Armor.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.text: Forces a Sanity roll on everyone who sees it for the first time.

trait: Incorporeal: nothing physical touches it except magic, silver, and Bright-imbued weapons (Chapter 8).
found: Haunted houses, Funayurei waters, the Catacombs.

name: Wraith

abilities.name: Mana Drain
abilities.text: Casts Mass Drain (Shade Rank 5) once per scene.

abilities.name: Soul Touch (melee)
abilities.text: Cold damage; ignores Armor.

trait: Incorporeal. Feeds on mana.
loot: Wraith essence (B rank Shade focus material).

name: Dullahan

abilities.name: Headless Charge
abilities.text: Rides 3 zones and attacks. Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Wail
abilities.text: Everyone who hears it makes a Sanity roll.

trait: A headless knight on a headless horse. It carries its head and sees through its eyes.

name: Death Knight

abilities.name: Cursed Sword (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Shadowflame
abilities.text: Casts Shadowflame (Fire + Shade).

abilities.name: Command Dead
abilities.text: Undead in sight add 2 dice to attacks.

trait: A fallen knight raised with its skill intact.

name: Vampire

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage; on a hit it drinks, gaining 1 mana and neutralizing 1 Bashing.

abilities.name: Blood Bolt
abilities.text: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 3 power (Chapter 8).

abilities.name: Blur
abilities.text: Casts the Celerity Rank 2 power.

trait: Vampires are a heritage (Chapter 8), and most are citizens like anyone else. This entry is for the ones who hunt. Each has a Compulsion tied to one of its scales.
found: Cities at night, old manors, the Shaded Isles.

name: Vampire Lord

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.text: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 6 power.

abilities.name: Command
abilities.text: A Dominion power: one target in sight resists with Wisdom + Composure or obeys a simple order on its turn.

abilities.name: Second Strike
abilities.text: Casts the Celerity Rank 4 power; two attacks a turn.

trait: An old vampire with a house of lesser vampires and human servants. Rarely fights its own battles until it has to.
loot: An A rank heirloom, a house's secrets.

name: Vampire Queen

abilities.name: Crimson Tide
abilities.text: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 7 power.

abilities.name: Exsanguinate
abilities.text: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 7 power on one target.

abilities.name: Dominion of the Court
abilities.text: Every vampire in sight adds 2 dice to every roll, and every enemy resists with Wisdom + Composure or loses its next action.

abilities.name: Undying
abilities.text: Neutralizes 2 Bashing and 1 Lethal each Upkeep while she has mana.

trait: The ruler of a vampire court, often centuries old. Her compulsion is the only weakness most of her enemies ever find.
found: The deepest courts of the Shaded Isles.
loot: An S rank artifact and a court's worth of debts.

name: Lich

abilities.name: Black Pulse
abilities.text: Casts the Shade Rank 6 spell.

abilities.name: Animate Dead
abilities.text: Casts the Shade Rank 5 spell.

abilities.name: Black Blizzard
abilities.text: Casts Black Blizzard (Fire + Water + Air + Shade) once per scene.

trait: Its soul is bound to a phylactery. Destroy the phylactery or it returns in a month.

name: Bone Dragon

abilities.name: Deathbreath
abilities.text: Ranged, a cone 3 zones long. Cold damage and everyone hit makes a Sanity roll.

abilities.name: Claws and Tail
abilities.text: Two melee attacks a turn; slashing damage.

trait: A dragon raised by a lich. Flies at double movement, if its wings still hold.

name: Fire Drake

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.text: Casts the Fire Rank 3 spell.

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

trait: Wingless and quick. Immune to Burning.

name: Frost Drake

abilities.name: Frost Breath
abilities.text: Casts Frost Lance (Water Rank 3) as a cone 2 zones long; everyone hit is Chilled.

abilities.name: Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

trait: Wingless and sure-footed on ice. Immune to Chilled.

name: Wyvern

abilities.name: Tail Stinger
abilities.text: Piercing damage and the Poisoned condition.

abilities.name: Dive
abilities.text: Moves 4 zones and attacks with +2 dice.

trait: Two legs, two wings, a bad temper. Flies at double movement.

name: Earth Dragon

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.text: Moves through earth and stone as if it were air, 2 zones per turn, and bursts out under a target with +3 dice.

abilities.name: Crushing Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Crushing damage.

abilities.name: Rock Barrage
abilities.text: Casts the Earth Rank 2 spell at everyone in adjacent zones.

trait: Wingless, enormous, and found in deep valleys where they lie still for years. Gives off tremors before it attacks.
found: Earth Dragon valleys of the Central Continent.
loot: Earth dragon scale (A rank armor material).

name: Red Wyrm

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.text: Casts Rain of Fire (Fire Rank 6).

abilities.name: Claws (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Flock
abilities.text: Red Wyrms hunt in groups; each adjacent wyrm adds 1 die to the others' attacks.

trait: Flies at double movement. The Red Wyrm Mountains are home to hundreds, and the passes are only safe in large caravans.
loot: Red wyrm scale (A rank), wyrm heart (S rank alchemy).

name: Blue Wyrm

abilities.name: Frost Breath
abilities.text: Casts Blizzard (Water Rank 6).

abilities.name: Tail Lash (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage, knocked back 2 zones.

trait: Swims as well as it flies. Lives on cold coasts and sea cliffs.

name: Storm Wyrm

abilities.name: Lightning Breath
abilities.text: Casts Plasma (Fire + Air) as a line 4 zones long.

abilities.name: Wing Gale
abilities.text: Casts Shearing Gale (Air Rank 5).

trait: Rides the edge of thunderstorms.

name: Dark Dragon

abilities.name: Shadowflame Breath
abilities.text: Casts Convergent Flame (Fire + Bright + Shade) as darkfire, or Shadowflame (Fire + Shade) as a cone.

abilities.name: Claws (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Dread Aura
abilities.text: Enemies within 2 zones make a Sanity roll at the start of the fight.

trait: A dark dragon is often seen flying over Gaslow, Atoferatofe's domain. Whether it serves her or simply likes the bog is a matter of debate.

name: Elder Dragon

abilities.name: Breath
abilities.text: Casts any rank 7 spell of either of its elements.

abilities.name: Claws, Wings, Tail
abilities.text: Three attacks a turn: slashing, kinetic, kinetic.

abilities.name: Scales
abilities.text: Takes half damage from spells, rounded down.

trait: Old, clever, and greedy. Most can speak and some will bargain.
loot: A hoard. Scales worth a fortune.

name: Ancient Dragon

abilities.name: Sovereign Breath
abilities.text: Casts a five-school combination spell made of its elements, such as Primordial Storm.

abilities.name: Claws, Wings, Tail, Bite
abilities.text: Four attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Ancient Scales
abilities.text: Takes half damage from spells, rounded down.

trait: Ancient Dragons are not beasts. They are people with their own goals, kingdoms, and grudges, as old as nations. Fighting one is a story arc, not an encounter. Vaelthrax, the Slime King's companion, is the most famous.
loot: Whatever they allow you to take.

name: Grindylow

abilities.name: Grasping Fingers (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage; the target is pulled one zone deeper into the water.

trait: Pale lake goblins with long, strong fingers. They drag swimmers down in groups.

name: Kappa

abilities.name: Sumo Grapple (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage and the target is knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Water Jet
abilities.text: Casts the Water Rank 2 spell.

trait: Turtle-shelled river folk with a water-filled dish on their heads. Bowing politely makes them bow back, spilling the water: they lose all their dice until they refill it. They love cucumbers and keep their promises.
found: Rivers and ponds of the eastern isles.
loot: Kappa medicine (heals as Basic healing, PHP 2).

name: Funayurei

abilities.name: Ladle
abilities.text: Fills a boat with water: each use, the boat takes kinetic damage to its Hull.

abilities.name: Drowning Grip (melee)
abilities.text: Cold damage; ignores Armor.

trait: Ghosts of drowned sailors. Giving them a ladle with no bottom keeps them busy until dawn.

name: Deep Raider

abilities.name: Trident (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Ink Cloud
abilities.text: Casts Mist (Fire + Water) as an ink cloud underwater.

trait: Fish-headed raiders from the dark water. Not to be confused with Fishfolk citizens (Chapter 8), who resent the comparison.

name: Giant Crab

abilities.name: Pincers (melee)
abilities.text: Crushing damage; the target is Rooted until it breaks free.

trait: Its shell gives +2 BDT against attacks from the front.
loot: Crab meat, shell (D rank shield material).

name: Kelpie

abilities.name: Enchanting Mane
abilities.text: Anyone who touches it is stuck fast and is dragged into deep water on its next turn.

abilities.name: Water Jet
abilities.text: Casts the Water Rank 2 spell.

abilities.name: Hooves (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

trait: A water horse that looks like a lost pony. A bridle made with its true name tames it.
loot: Kelpie hair (C rank focus material: Water).

name: Siren

abilities.name: Song
abilities.text: Everyone who hears it resists with Composure + Insight or must move one zone toward her on their turn.

abilities.name: Claws (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

trait: Covering your ears gives -2 dice to Awareness but immunity to the song.

name: Sea Serpent

abilities.name: Coil (melee)
abilities.text: Crushing damage to a ship's Hull or a creature.

abilities.name: Tidal Pull
abilities.text: Casts the Water Rank 5 spell.

trait: Can wrap a corvette and drag it under.

name: Umibozu

abilities.name: Rising Dark
abilities.text: Appears beside a ship in calm water; the crew makes a Sanity roll.

abilities.name: Swamp the Deck
abilities.text: Casts Deluge (Water Rank 7) on a ship.

abilities.name: Demand
abilities.text: Asks for a barrel. Giving it a barrel with no bottom ends the encounter.

trait: A vast black shape with pale eyes that rises out of a calm sea. Rarely fought, often survived by good manners.

name: Kraken

abilities.name: Tentacles
abilities.text: Four attacks a turn against creatures or a ship's Hull; crushing damage.

abilities.name: Ink
abilities.text: Casts Mist (Fire + Water); everyone in it is blinded.

trait: Each tentacle has its own boxes (a quarter of the total); cut one off and it loses an attack.

name: Leviathan

abilities.name: Drowned World
abilities.text: Casts Drowned World (Water + Air + Earth + Nature + Shade).

abilities.name: Swallow Ship
abilities.text: Swallows a ship up to frigate size.

abilities.name: Whirlpool
abilities.text: Every ship within 6 zones is pulled 2 zones toward it each turn.

trait: A creature from the oldest stories. It has been seen twice in recorded history.

name: Pixie
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Pixie Dust
abilities.text: Casts Decrease Weight (Air + Bright + Shade) on an ally, or a prank: the target suffers -2 dice on its next roll.

abilities.name: Glamour
abilities.text: Becomes invisible until it attacks.

trait: Tiny, playful, and easily offended. Flies at double movement.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Lure
abilities.text: Anyone following it resists with Wisdom + Insight or follows it off the path.

trait: Leads lost travelers somewhere, not always where they meant to go.

name: Dream Stag
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Antler Charge
abilities.text: Move 3 zones and attack; kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Mending Bloom
abilities.text: Casts Mending Bloom (Nature + Bright) on a creature it trusts.

trait: A white stag that appears to people who need a reason to keep going.
loot: Never taken; it gives a blessing instead.

name: Kitsune Trickster
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Foxfire
abilities.text: Casts Radiant Flame (Fire + Bright).

abilities.name: Illusion
abilities.text: Casts Mirror Mist (Water + Air + Bright + Shade) once per scene.

trait: A fox spirit with more than one tail. Loves riddles, fried tofu, and embarrassing the proud.
found: Shrines, the eastern isles, the Dreeming.
loot: A tail-hair charm (C rank Fire focus).

name: Nightmare Imp
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Nightmare Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage; the target makes a Sanity roll.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.text: Becomes invisible in darkness.

trait: Rides sleepers' chests and feeds on their fear.

name: Redcap
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Pike (melee, Reach)
abilities.text: Piercing damage. Every hit reddens its cap and adds 1 die to its next attack.

abilities.name: Iron Boots
abilities.text: Cannot be knocked Prone or moved.

trait: Murderous goblin-like fey. Reading scripture aloud, or a cross of iron, makes it flee.

name: Bogeyman
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: From the Dark
abilities.text: Steps from any shadow to any other shadow in sight.

abilities.name: Terror
abilities.text: Casts Fog of Dread (Shade Rank 3); everyone in it makes a Sanity roll.

abilities.name: Claws (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

trait: Made from every child's fear of the closet. Bright light hurts it: +2 dice to attacks against it in a lit zone.

name: Hag of the Seeming
section: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.text: Casts Cursed Roots (Earth + Nature + Shade).

abilities.name: Bargain
abilities.text: Offers a deal; refusing costs nothing, accepting always costs more than it seems.

abilities.name: Plague Fog
abilities.text: Casts Plague Fog (Water + Air + Nature + Shade) once per scene.

trait: Hags trade in names, years, and memories.

name: Voidling Mite

abilities.name: Feed
abilities.text: Every creature in adjacent zones loses 1 mana; one with no mana takes cold damage instead.

trait: A swarm of small, wrong shapes. Area attacks deal +2 damage to it.

name: Voidling Stalker

abilities.name: Phase Strike
abilities.text: Teleports up to 3 zones and attacks; slashing damage that ignores Armor.

abilities.name: Mana Hunger
abilities.text: Adds 2 dice to attacks against whoever has the most mana.

trait: Seeing one for the first time forces a Sanity roll.

name: Void Maw

abilities.name: Devour (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage; the target loses mana equal to the damage boxes it marks.

abilities.name: Pull
abilities.text: Every creature within 3 zones is pulled one zone toward it each Upkeep.

trait: A mouth with nothing behind it.

name: Voidling Horror

abilities.name: Unmake
abilities.text: Casts Soul Drain (Shade Rank 7).

abilities.name: Tendrils
abilities.text: Three attacks a turn; cold damage.

abilities.name: Wrongness
abilities.text: Everyone in sight makes a Sanity roll each turn.

trait: What comes through when a Void opening tears wide.

name: Void Leviathan

abilities.name: Black Tide
abilities.text: Casts Black Blizzard (Fire + Water + Air + Shade) as a wave.

abilities.name: Swallow Mana
abilities.text: Every creature in sight loses mana equal to the Leviathan's rank each turn.

trait: A Void creature large enough to swim between worlds.
found: The Outer Dark, deep Void breaches.

name: Void Kaiju

abilities.name: Tidal Smash
abilities.text: Casts Monsoon (Water + Air + Earth + Nature).

abilities.name: Stomp and Crush
abilities.text: Two attacks a turn against everything in a 2x2 area; kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Armored Hide
abilities.text: Takes half damage from anything without Armor or Magic Penetration.

abilities.name: Wrongness
abilities.text: Everyone who sees it makes a Sanity roll.

trait: The smallest of the Kaiju, and still an S rank threat. About once a year one breaks out of the Rift at the center of the Ringus Sea, and the HRC and the Titans meet it before it reaches a shore (Chapter 3).
found: The Rift in the Ringus Sea, other Void breaches.
loot: A Kaiju core: worth a King's Gold to the right buyer.

name: Giant Void Kaiju

abilities.name: Nightfall
abilities.text: Casts Nightfall (Fire + Water + Air + Earth + Nature + Shade).

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.text: Four attacks a turn against everything in a 5x5 area.

abilities.name: Wrongness
abilities.text: Everyone within sight makes a Sanity roll every turn, at -2 dice.

abilities.name: Endless
abilities.text: Takes half damage from everything that is not a combination spell or an S rank weapon.

trait: The worst thing the Void has ever sent. Nations, the HRC, and the Titans together have stopped one only twice.
loot: A continent's worth of salvage, if anything survives.

name: Bandit

abilities.name: Short Sword (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Crossbow
abilities.text: Ranged, line of sight. Piercing damage, Reload (1).

trait: Runs when half the gang is down.

name: Thug

abilities.name: Club (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Gang Up
abilities.text: +2 dice when another thug is adjacent to the target.

trait: Usually works for someone worse.

name: City Guard

abilities.name: Spear (melee, Reach)
abilities.text: Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Whistle
abilities.text: Calls 1d10 more guards over the next 3 turns.

trait: Would rather arrest you than kill you.

name: Mercenary

abilities.name: Weapon (melee or ranged)
abilities.text: Damage by weapon type.

abilities.name: Professional
abilities.text: Retreats if the pay stops being worth it.

trait: Members of the Mercenaries Guild in space, or freelancers on Terrana.

name: Veteran Delver

abilities.name: Signature Weapon (melee)
abilities.text: Damage by weapon type, two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: School Spell
abilities.text: Casts one rank 3 spell of its school.

trait: Has been to the fortieth floor and has the scars.

name: Knight

abilities.name: Longsword (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: Allies in adjacent zones add 1 to BDT.

trait: Sworn to a house or a crown.

name: Battle Mage

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.text: Casts a rank 2 spell of either school.

abilities.name: Combination
abilities.text: Casts a two-school combination spell of its schools once per scene.

trait: Usually trained at Monsera University.

name: Assassin

abilities.name: Poisoned Blade (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage and the Poisoned condition; +3 dice against a target that has not acted yet this fight.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: Casts the Shade Rank 4 spell.

trait: Works for the Shaded Isles, a noble house, or the highest bidder.

name: Necromancer

abilities.name: Animate Dead
abilities.text: Casts the Shade Rank 5 spell.

abilities.name: Corruption Bolt
abilities.text: Casts the Shade Rank 2 spell.

trait: Rarely alone: usually surrounded by 3 to 6 Skeletons or Zombies.

name: Sword Saint

abilities.name: Saint's Cut (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; three attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Counter
abilities.text: When its defense beats an attack, it strikes back with the same roll (Chapter 12).

trait: A Saint rank master of a Combat Style. The Sword God's schools produce a handful a generation.

name: Empress Kishirika Kishirisu

abilities.name: Magic Eyes
abilities.text: Her eyes see anything she chooses: lies, futures, distant places. She knows what every enemy in sight is about to do (+5 dice to defense rolls).

abilities.name: Gift an Eye
abilities.text: Grants a Magic Eye (Chapter 9) to someone who helped her.

trait: The Demon Empress is famously weak in a fight, famously hungry, and famously generous to whoever feeds her. She has died and reincarnated at least five times. Rank C is her fighting strength, not her importance.
found: Wherever she wandered off to this time.
loot: A Magic Eye, if she likes you.

name: Badigadi, the Fighting God

abilities.name: Six Arms
abilities.text: Six attacks a turn, kinetic damage. He laughs through all of them.

abilities.name: Undying Flesh
abilities.text: Neutralizes all Bashing and Lethal damage each Upkeep, and regrows anything lost by the next scene. Only sealing him stops him.

abilities.name: Fighting God
abilities.text: Wearing his legendary armor, his Attack pool rises by 5 and he casts Omega Burst (Battle Aura Rank 7) at will.

trait: Six-armed, loud, and delighted by a good fight or a good party. He has little magical aptitude and needs none. He is the husband of Kishirika and one of the few beings the Slime King treats as a peer.
found: Biegoya, in the far northeast, or wherever the wine is.

name: Atoferatofe Ryback

abilities.name: Demon Sword (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; four attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Undying Flesh
abilities.text: As Badigadi.

abilities.name: Conscription
abilities.text: Anyone she defeats becomes her disciple, whether they like it or not.

trait: Badigadi's sister: enormously strong, very loud, and not interested in nuance. She kidnaps foreign royalty and challenges every strong warrior she hears of. Her black-armored Imperial Guard follow her everywhere.
found: Gaslow, a dark bog in the east, under the shadow of a dark dragon.

name: Atofe's Imperial Guard

abilities.name: Black Blade (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; two attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Formation
abilities.text: Each guard adjacent to another adds 1 to its BDT.

trait: Black-armored disciples, nearly all of them former challengers who lost.

name: Necross Lacross

abilities.name: Five Elements
abilities.text: Casts Primordial Storm (Fire + Water + Air + Earth + Nature), or any spell of the five elemental schools.

abilities.name: Strongest Fortress
abilities.text: In his fortress, every ally adds 2 to BDT and he sees every corridor.

abilities.name: Undying Flesh
abilities.text: As Badigadi.

trait: The Five Elements Demon King, a tactician of the God Wars, father of Badigadi and Atoferatofe, and the one who brought Kishirika to Terrana. He built the strongest fortress on the Demon Continent and rules from its heart.
found: The heart of the Demon Continent.
loot: Strategy, if he deigns to share it.

name: The Earth God

abilities.name: Redesign
abilities.text: Changes the terrain of up to 10 zones each turn: walls, pits, rivers, stairs.

abilities.name: Continental Shift
abilities.text: Casts the Earth Rank 7 spell.

abilities.name: Creative Director
abilities.text: Inside the Grand Dungeon, she can teleport anyone on any floor to any other floor.

trait: A fairy-type Immortal Demon King who co-owns the Grand Dungeon with the Slime King and redesigns its floors on a whim. Fighting her in her dungeon is a very bad idea.
loot: A new floor named after you, if she is amused.

name: Beethove Tovetha

abilities.name: Ink Tentacles
abilities.text: Four attacks a turn; kinetic damage, and every hit records the target's memories in ink.

abilities.name: Library
abilities.text: Knows everything ever written. Adds 5 dice to any Intelligence roll.

trait: A monstrous black slime-octopus who rules the Library Labyrinth and records every piece of written lore in the world.
found: The Library Labyrinth, in the north.
loot: A book you were looking for.

name: Raja Iblis Baglahagla

abilities.name: King's Cleaver (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage; three attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Royal Feast
abilities.text: Every orc in sight neutralizes 1 Bashing and adds 1 die to attacks this turn.

trait: The pig-like King of the Orcs, ruler of the northwest. Judges a guest by their appetite.

name: Vita, the Abyssal King

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.text: A creature that ingests Vita resists with Wisdom + Composure each turn; on a failure Vita controls its body and floods its mind with visions.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: Can exist in many drops at once.

trait: A parasitic blue slime-demon. Its rank is low because it rarely fights with its own body; the body it is wearing decides how dangerous it is.
found: The western domain, or inside anyone.

name: Lynebyne, the Stone King

abilities.name: Stone Fortress
abilities.text: Casts the Earth Rank 6 spell.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.text: Casts Petrify (Earth + Nature + Bright + Shade).

abilities.name: Stone Body
abilities.text: Takes half damage from everything but Air and Nature attacks.

trait: The ruler of the southwest, as patient as the mountains.

name: Samedynomedy, Demon King of Light

abilities.name: Final Light
abilities.text: Casts the Bright Rank 7 spell.

abilities.name: Radiance
abilities.text: Undead and Void creatures within 3 zones take radiant damage each Upkeep.

trait: Ruler of the south, whose domain is never truly dark.

name: Patorsetor, the Enchantress Demon King

abilities.name: Enchant
abilities.text: Every enemy in sight resists with Wisdom + Composure or fights for her this turn.

abilities.name: Mirror Mist
abilities.text: Casts Mirror Mist (Water + Air + Bright + Shade).

trait: Ruler of the southeastern coast, whose court is full of people who do not remember arriving.

name: Qeblaqabla, the Evil Demon King

abilities.name: Black Rain
abilities.text: Casts Black Pulse (Shade Rank 6) as a rain of black liquid across 3x3 zones.

abilities.name: Corrode
abilities.text: Anything it touches loses 1 Rating or 1 Armor.

trait: A floating orb leaking black liquid, ruling the continent's southern end.
found: The southern end of the Demon Continent.

name: Warchief Gruk Ironmaw

abilities.name: Cleaver (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Warband
abilities.text: Arrives with 6 Goblins; each turn Gruk shouts, they add 1 die to attacks.

trait: Thirty years on the job. Respects a fair fight.

name: The Grand Beastmaster

abilities.name: Whip (melee, Reach)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Command Beast
abilities.text: Its Chimera (see Beasts) acts twice this turn.

trait: Fights beside a multi-headed Chimera in the Ironwood Colosseum while the stands bet on the outcome.

name: Asterion of the Maze

abilities.name: Labrys (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Hunter's Ear
abilities.text: Always knows where every enemy on the floor is.

trait: Waits at the Labyrinth's final gate.
loot: C rank axe, a map that is always wrong.

name: The Chrono-Goliath

abilities.name: Gear Crush (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Shift the Floor
abilities.text: Changes the speed of the floor's machinery: platforms move 1 zone and steam pipes burst (burning damage) each turn.

trait: The Shattered Clockwork, built by the Makers Guild long ago.

name: Skyrend, the Storm Alpha

abilities.name: Lightning Dive
abilities.text: Moves 4 zones and attacks; electric damage, and the target is knocked off any branch.

abilities.name: Thunderstorm
abilities.text: Casts Thunderstorm (Fire + Water + Air + Nature).

trait: Rules the Canopy Wilds.

name: The Kraken Vanguard

abilities.name: Sweeping Trident (melee, Reach)
abilities.text: Piercing damage to everyone in adjacent zones.

abilities.name: Current
abilities.text: Every enemy is pushed 1 zone each Upkeep.

trait: A Seafolk champion under contract with the Navigators Guild.

name: The Iron Juggernaut

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.text: Moves 2 zones in a line and attacks; kinetic damage.

abilities.name: Front Plate
abilities.text: Its BDT doubles against attacks from the front.

trait: A walking furnace built to clear cave-ins.

name: The Doppler Matriarch

abilities.name: Mirror Copies
abilities.text: Creates a solid copy of each party member with their stats and abilities.

abilities.name: Mirror Mist
abilities.text: Casts Mirror Mist (Water + Air + Bright + Shade).

trait: A high-tier devil illusionist from Nite City.

name: Mother Maelis, the Siren Matron

abilities.name: Matron's Song
abilities.text: Every enemy resists with Composure + Insight or moves 2 zones toward the rising water.

abilities.name: Tempest
abilities.text: Casts Tempest (Water + Air).

trait: The eldest of the ruins' sirens.

name: Cindermaw, the Magma Wyrm

abilities.name: Magma Breath
abilities.text: Casts Lava (Fire + Earth + Nature).

abilities.name: Melt the Arena
abilities.text: Each turn, one zone of the platform melts away.

trait: A wild fire drake fused with experimental company machinery.

name: The Rune Sentinel

abilities.name: Rune Blast
abilities.text: Casts Disruption (Bright + Shade).

abilities.name: Riddles
abilities.text: Asks three questions before the fight; each answered well costs it a Boss template benefit.

trait: An ancient guardian covered in shifting runes.

name: The Dullahan Overseer

abilities.name: Wall Walk
abilities.text: Steps through walls to cut off retreat.

abilities.name: Deadly Wail
abilities.text: Everyone makes a Sanity roll and resists with Fortitude + Endurance or loses their next action.

trait: An ancient knight representing the noble houses of the Shaded Isles.

name: Conductor Kessler

abilities.name: Last Train
abilities.text: The ghost train charges through a line of zones; kinetic damage to everyone in it.

abilities.name: Ticket, Please
abilities.text: Anyone without a valid ticket suffers -2 dice on all rolls.

trait: Insists every passenger present a valid ticket. Bring one.

name: Warden Arcanum

abilities.name: Absorb
abilities.text: Any single-school spell that hits it is absorbed and adds 2 dice to its next attack.

abilities.name: Circuit Lightning
abilities.text: Casts Thunderstorm (Fire + Water + Air + Nature).

trait: An advanced defense construct from the Mages Guild. Physical attacks and combination spells are the way through.

name: The Crystal Basilisk

abilities.name: Crystal Gaze
abilities.text: As a Basilisk's gaze, but flesh turns to crystal.

abilities.name: Shard Burst
abilities.text: Casts Glass Shards (Fire + Air + Earth).

trait: Its hide is a living crystal lattice.

name: The Rift Stalker

abilities.name: Phase Hunt
abilities.text: Teleports anywhere on the ledge and attacks; slashing damage that ignores Armor.

abilities.name: Void Wind
abilities.text: Every enemy is pulled one zone toward the edge each Upkeep.

trait: A real multi-dimensional predator, held on this floor by magic barriers.

name: The Monk of a Thousand Steps

abilities.name: Thousand Fists (melee)
abilities.text: Kinetic damage; four attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Aura Ascendant
abilities.text: Casts the Battle Aura Rank 7 spell.

abilities.name: Tireless
abilities.text: Never suffers wound penalties.

trait: A silent ogre who fights unarmed and will not let a party pass until they prove themselves.

name: The Devil Prince Defiler

abilities.name: Hellfire Blade (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage and the Burning condition.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.text: Casts Shadowflame (Fire + Shade) or Black Lightning (Fire + Air + Nature + Shade).

trait: An exile from the Hell Dungeon and a true spellsword, under contract to the Earth God.

name: Vaelthrax

abilities.name: Ancient Breath
abilities.text: Casts Sunfall (Fire + Water + Air + Earth + Bright).

abilities.name: Claws, Wings, Tail, Bite
abilities.text: Four attacks a turn.

abilities.name: Undefeated
abilities.text: Near-total immunity to magic: spells deal only a quarter of their damage, rounded down.

trait: The Slime King's legendary companion and the final boss. No gimmicks: only immense strength, near-total immunity to magic, and devastating breath. No party has beaten it.

name: Sky Pirate

abilities.name: Cutlass (melee)
abilities.text: Slashing damage.

abilities.name: Boarding Hook
abilities.text: Swings 3 zones from ship to ship and attacks.

trait: Crews wooden warships driven by Air Magic circles.

name: Sky Pirate Captain

abilities.name: Blaster and Cutlass
abilities.text: One melee and one ranged attack a turn.

abilities.name: Broadside
abilities.text: Orders the ship's guns: every enemy ship in sight takes kinetic damage to its Hull.

trait: Every captain has a price on their head and a legend to protect.
loot: A ship, if you can take it.

name: Asteroid Burrower

abilities.name: Drill Bite (melee)
abilities.text: Piercing damage, double against a ship's Hull.

trait: Lives inside drifting rocks and mistakes hulls for food.

name: Nebula Wraith

abilities.name: Static Touch
abilities.text: Electric damage; a ship it touches loses one crew station for a turn.

trait: A ghost of gas and lightning.

name: Nyxhollow Swarm

abilities.name: Feed
abilities.text: Every creature within 2 zones loses 2 mana.

abilities.name: Wrongness
abilities.text: Sanity roll at first sight.

trait: Voidlings from Nyxhollow, where the swarms never thin.

name: Star Whale

abilities.name: Song
abilities.text: Every creature that hears it neutralizes 1 Bashing and loses all fear conditions.

abilities.name: Tail Slap
abilities.text: Kinetic damage to a ship's Hull, if provoked.

trait: Peaceful giants that swim between worlds. Sailors consider them good luck.
